senses.gloss: (= (= אילו־מא־לָא) if in any way not, if not, but for (usu. without verb or followed by שֶׁ־ or דְּ־; cmp. אִלֵּימָא I, 1).
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 49a:10">Snh. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ דוד וכ׳</he> but for David (studying the Law), Joab could wage no war.
<cite ref="Megillah 12b:12">Meg. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ אגרות וכ׳</he> but for the previous letters. Tanḥ. Ḥukkath 1 (ed. Bub. 1 <he>אם לא</he>); a. fr.
<cite ref="Megillah 24b:11">Meg. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>אלמלי אתה לוי</he> [Ms. M. <he>אלמלא לוי אתה</he>) if thou wert a Levite.
<cite ref="Ketubot 33b:1">Keth. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>אלמלא נגדוה וכ׳</he> if they had lashed Hananiah &c.

<cite ref="Shabbat 118b:4">Sabb. 118ᵇ</cite>; a. fr. [A differentiation of spelling which may have existed for the two opposite meanings of our w., is untraceable; v. Lowe, Pesachim, p. 28.] Cmp. <cite ref="A01281"><he>אִילּוּלֵי</he></cite>.
